description: FK → Calendar Date Dimension. Date key: Decision Date (Nguồn B — join qua Violation Case → Examination Team, không qua Violation Record)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN violation_case_received_document ON violation_case_received_document.violation_record_id = violation_record_behavior.violation_record_id AND violation_case_received_document.violation_record_id IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN violation_case ON violation_case.violation_case_id = violation_case_received_document.violation_case_id AND violation_case.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_CASE' AND violation_case.examination_team_id IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = violation_case.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' → LOOKUP cdr_dt_dim ON cdr_dt_dim.cdr_dt = examination_team.decision_dt AND examination_team.ds_rcrd_isrt_dt = :etl_date

etl_logic: INNER JOIN violation_case_received_document ON violation_case_received_document.violation_record_id = violation_record_behavior.violation_record_id AND violation_case_received_document.violation_record_id IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN violation_case ON violation_case.violation_case_id = violation_case_received_document.violation_case_id AND violation_case.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_CASE' AND violation_case.examination_team_id IS NOT NULL → LOOKUP examination_team_dim ON examination_team_dim.examination_team_code = violation_case.examination_team_code
